evals.prompt: Create a blue button component named Atoms/Button in my Figma file
evals.expected_output: A component node named Atoms/Button with blue fill and text child
expectations: A ComponentNode or ComponentSetNode named 'Atoms/Button' exists on the page
The component has a blue fill (r < 0.3, g < 0.5, b > 0.8)
The component contains a TEXT child with characters 'Button'
Auto Layout is applied (layoutMode is HORIZONTAL or VERTICAL)
figma.commitUndo() was called

evals.prompt: Change the heading text in my login screen to 'Welcome'
evals.expected_output: The heading text node updated to 'Welcome' with font preserved
expectations: Worker reads the current node state before modifying
Font was loaded before setting characters
Text node characters === 'Welcome'
Original font family and style are preserved
Worker verified the change after applying it

evals.prompt: Show me the structure of this Figma file
evals.expected_output: Page name, frame names, types, and IDs returned
expectations: Returns the current page name
Returns all top-level frame names and IDs
Returns node types for each frame
Uses Plugin API (not REST) for reading
No mutations were made to the file

evals.prompt: Build a card component with a title, description, and image placeholder
evals.expected_output: A component with Auto Layout containing title text, description text, and an image rectangle
expectations: A ComponentNode named with 'Card' exists
Has vertical Auto Layout with appropriate padding and gap
Contains a TEXT child for title (Bold font)
Contains a TEXT child for description (Regular font)
Contains a rectangle or frame for image placeholder
All children are properly parented (verified via parent.id check)

evals.prompt: Add a drop shadow to the main frame in my Figma file
evals.expected_output: The frame has a DROP_SHADOW effect applied
expectations: Worker reads the current effects array before modifying
Effects array was cloned (not mutated in place)
A DROP_SHADOW effect exists in node.effects
Shadow has visible: true and reasonable radius/offset values
Existing effects on the node were preserved
